items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Bubber Brower Miley was sort of like a neighbor; he lived around the corner -- and I admired him greatly.

ctx.x: And he played great trumpet. And Bubber Brower Miley was sort of like a neighbor; he lived around the corner -- and I admired him greatly. So I really wanted

to play the trumpet. I went and bought a trumpet, paying for it, I think, $33 -- well, not I I don't think, I know -- because I remember it very well, that it was $33, and I paid for it in 33 weeks. That was not really what we called the installment plan today; it was what we called the 'layaway' plan because you didn't get it until that last dollar had also been laid away, and until then, the instrument was laid away for you.
